1.w: My son, if you receive my words and you treasure my commands within you,

2.w: to make your ear attentive to wisdom, you incline your heart to understanding.

3.w: For if you call out for understanding, [and] for insight you give forth your voice,

4.w: if you seek her like silver, and like hidden treasures you search for her,

5.w: then you will understand the fear of YHWH, and the knowledge of God you will find.

6.w: For YHWH gives wisdom; from His mouth [is] knowledge and understanding.

7.w: He stores up for the upright good sense—protection for those walking with integrity.

8.w: He watches over the paths of justice, and the way of His holy ones He guards.

9.w: Then you will understand righteousness and justice and uprightness, every good path.

10.w: For wisdom will enter into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

11.w: Discretion will guard over you; understanding will guard you,

12.w: to snatch you from the way of evil, from the man speaking perversity—

13.w: those abandoning the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,

14.w: those glad to do evil, they rejoice in the perversity of evil,

15.w: whose ways [are] crooked, and [who] are turning aside in their paths.

16.w: It will deliver you from a strange woman, from a foreign woman having made smooth her words,

17.w: the one having forsaken the guide of her youth, and she has forgotten the covenant of her God.

18.w: For her house sinks down to death, and her paths to the Rephaim.

19.w: Of all those coming to her, none will return, nor will they reach the paths of life.

20.w: So you must walk in the way of the good ones, and guard the paths of the righteous ones.

21.w: For the upright will dwell in the land, and the blameless ones will remain in it.

22.w: And the wicked will be cut off from the earth, and treacherous ones will be plucked out from it.
